description: Use this for January-February cherry blossom requests or when the user specifically asks about Kawazu-zakura, early blossoms, or the Izu Peninsula. Returns the Japan Meteorological Corporation forecast comment, forecast map links, and Kawazu cherry spots with bloom percentages, full-bloom percentages, forecast dates, and coordinates. Do not use this for standard Somei-Yoshino sakura elsewhere in Japan.

include_spots.description: Whether to include the full list of Kawazu viewing spots. Defaults to true. Set false when the user only needs the overall forecast summary and map.
include_spots.title: Include Spot Listings

spot_name.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter for a specific Kawazu landmark or area, such as '原木', '駅前', 'iZoo', or '七滝'. Use this when the user asks about one named spot instead of the full list.
spot_name.title: Spot Name Filter

name: kawazu_forecast

answer.description: The tool's user-facing answer as Markdown or JSON text.
